title: HSK 2.12 · 网站, 报名, 手表, 黄色
focus: 表 · 船 · 养 · 鸡 · 遍 · 瓶 · 咱们 · 顺利 · 网 · 借 · 封 · 蛋 · 占 · 词 · 鸟 · 蓝 · 纸 · 背 · 一生 · 黄 · 网站 · 出生 · 名单 · 报纸 · 单位 · 大人 · 主人 · 白色 · 蓝色 · 出门 · 咱 · 姓 · 大门 · 黄色 · 姓名 · 座位 · 报名 · 网球 · 手表
body:
Colors (白色, 蓝色, 黄色), names and lists (名单, 姓名, 报名), and the net 网 (网站, 网球). Watch 名, 色, 网, 报 and 单 come back again and again.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 网 | wǎng | net; internet (a frame with crossed cords) | 网, 网站, 网球 |
| 名 | míng | name | 名单, 姓名, 报名 |
| 色 | sè | color | 白色, 蓝色, 黄色 |
| 出 | chū | go out, come out | 出生, 出门 |
| 报 | bào | report; newspaper | 报纸, 报名 |
| 单 | dān | single; list, sheet | 名单, 单位 |
| 位 | wèi | place, position (亻 person + 立 stand) | 单位, 座位 |
| 表 | biǎo | surface; watch; form | 表, 手表 |

## Watch out

- 背 has two readings: bèi (the back; to memorize) and bēi (to carry on your back).
- 鸟 niǎo bird vs 乌 wū crow: the crow has no dot (eye).
- 咱们 always includes the listener; 我们 may not.

cards.Example: 我的表慢了。 wǒ de biǎo màn le: My watch is slow.
cards.Notes: Top + 衣 clothing split around it: an outer garment, so surface; simplified 表 also stands for 錶 watch

cards.Example: 我们坐船去吧。 wǒmen zuò chuán qù ba: Let's go by boat.
cards.Notes: 舟 boat + 㕣 (phonetic)

cards.Example: 我家养了一只猫。 wǒ jiā yǎng le yì zhī māo: My family has a cat.
cards.Notes: Top is 羊 yáng (sheep) for the sound; traditional 養 = 羊 + 食 food: feeding

cards.Example: 我想吃鸡肉。 wǒ xiǎng chī jīròu: I want some chicken.
cards.Notes: 又 (simplification shorthand) + 鸟 bird; 鸡蛋 = chicken egg

cards.Meaning: (measure: times, start to finish); all over
cards.Example: 请再说一遍。 qǐng zài shuō yí biàn: Please say it again.
cards.Notes: 辶 walk + 扁 biǎn for the sound: go all the way through; lookalike 篇 piān (article)

cards.Example: 给我一瓶水。 gěi wǒ yì píng shuǐ: Give me a bottle of water.
cards.Notes: 并 bìng for the sound + 瓦 pottery: a clay jar

cards.Example: 咱们走吧。 zánmen zǒu ba: Let's go.
cards.Notes: 咱 = 口 mouth + 自 self, + 们 plural; unlike 我们, always includes the listener

cards.Example: 一切都很顺利。 yíqiè dōu hěn shùnlì: Everything went smoothly.
cards.Notes: 顺 go along with (川 river + 页 head) + 利 favorable = going with the flow, smooth

cards.Example: 我在网上买的。 wǒ zài wǎng shang mǎi de: I bought it online.
cards.Notes: A picture of a net: frame 冂 with crossed cords inside

cards.Example: 能借我一支笔吗？ néng jiè wǒ yì zhī bǐ ma: Can I borrow a pen?
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 昔 xī (phonetic); 借给 = lend to

cards.Example: 我写了一封信。 wǒ xiě le yì fēng xìn: I wrote a letter.
cards.Notes: 圭 (two 土 earth) + 寸 hand

cards.Example: 我早上吃鸡蛋。 wǒ zǎoshang chī jīdàn: I eat eggs in the morning.
cards.Notes: Top 疋 + 虫 creature at the bottom

cards.Example: 别占我的座位。 bié zhàn wǒ de zuòwèi: Don't take my seat.
cards.Notes: 卜 divination crack + 口 mouth; also the sound part of 站 zhàn

cards.Example: 这个词什么意思？ zhège cí shénme yìsi: What does this word mean?
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 司 sī (phonetic)

cards.Example: 树上有一只鸟。 shù shang yǒu yì zhī niǎo: There's a bird in the tree.
cards.Notes: A picture of a bird; lookalike 乌 wū (crow) has no dot for the eye

cards.Example: 天很蓝。 tiān hěn lán: The sky is so blue.
cards.Notes: 艹 plant + 监 jiān (phonetic): the indigo plant used for blue dye

cards.Example: 给我一张纸。 gěi wǒ yì zhāng zhǐ: Give me a sheet of paper.
cards.Notes: 纟 silk + 氏 shì (phonetic); lookalike 低 dī (low)

cards.Meaning: back; to memorize (bèi); to carry on back (bēi)
cards.Example: 我在背生词。 wǒ zài bèi shēngcí: I'm memorizing new words.
cards.Notes: 北 (two people back to back) + 月 body = the back

cards.Example: 他一生都住在这里。 tā yìshēng dōu zhù zài zhèlǐ: He lived here all his life.
cards.Notes: 一 one + 生 life = one whole life

cards.Example: 树叶黄了。 shùyè huáng le: The leaves have turned yellow.
cards.Notes: Top 龷 + 由 + 八 at the bottom; also a very common surname

cards.Example: 这个网站很好用。 zhège wǎngzhàn hěn hǎoyòng: This website is easy to use.
cards.Notes: 网 net + 站 station = a station on the net

cards.Example: 我在北京出生。 wǒ zài Běijīng chūshēng: I was born in Beijing.
cards.Notes: 出 come out + 生 life = come out into life

cards.Example: 名单上有你。 míngdān shang yǒu nǐ: You're on the list.
cards.Notes: 名 name + 单 sheet, list

cards.Example: 爷爷每天看报纸。 yéye měi tiān kàn bàozhǐ: Grandpa reads the paper every day.
cards.Notes: 报 report + 纸 paper = report paper

cards.Example: 你在哪个单位工作？ nǐ zài nǎge dānwèi gōngzuò: Where do you work?
cards.Notes: 单 single + 位 place = one unit; in China, your employer

cards.Example: 我们都是大人了。 wǒmen dōu shì dàrén le: We're all grown-ups now.
cards.Notes: 大 is a person 人 with arms stretched wide

cards.Example: 这只狗的主人是谁？ zhè zhī gǒu de zhǔrén shì shéi: Who owns this dog?
cards.Notes: 主 master + 人 person

cards.Example: 我要白色的。 wǒ yào báisè de: I want the white one.
cards.Notes: 白 white + 色 color

cards.Example: 她穿着蓝色的裙子。 tā chuānzhe lánsè de qúnzi: She's wearing a blue skirt.
cards.Notes: 蓝 blue + 色 color

cards.Example: 我正要出门。 wǒ zhèng yào chūmén: I'm just heading out.
cards.Notes: 出 go out + 门 door

cards.Example: 咱俩一起去。 zán liǎ yìqǐ qù: The two of us will go together.
cards.Notes: 口 mouth + 自 self; usually in 咱们

cards.Example: 她姓马。 tā xìng mǎ: Her surname is Ma.
cards.Notes: 女 + 生 shēng: old surnames came from the mother's line

cards.Example: 大门开着。 dàmén kāizhe: The front gate is open.
cards.Notes: 大 big + 门 door

cards.Example: 我喜欢黄色。 wǒ xǐhuan huángsè: I like yellow.
cards.Notes: 黄 yellow + 色 color

cards.Example: 请写上你的姓名。 qǐng xiěshang nǐ de xìngmíng: Please write your full name.
cards.Notes: 姓 surname + 名 given name = full name

cards.Example: 这儿有座位吗？ zhèr yǒu zuòwèi ma: Is this seat free?
cards.Notes: 座 seat (广 building + 坐 sit) + 位 place

cards.Example: 我已经报名了。 wǒ yǐjīng bàomíng le: I've already signed up.
cards.Notes: 报 report + 名 name = hand in your name

cards.Example: 我们去打网球吧。 wǒmen qù dǎ wǎngqiú ba: Let's go play tennis.
cards.Notes: 网 net + 球 ball = net ball

cards.Example: 这是新手表。 zhè shì xīn shǒubiǎo: This is a new watch.
cards.Notes: 手 hand + 表 watch = wristwatch
